scope: 4 methods x 5 datasets, no standalone Pets, but Het5 still contains Pets37
mode: read-only-source audit and plan artifacts only

entrypoint.environment_status: Available documented environment witness from Sep18 CopyFlatCV only; historical March environment equivalence not established; no new import/GPU preflight run.

old_seed0_reuse_requirements: Recover immutable source/dependency state associated with the original March run, including shared backbone, scheduler, data loaders, metrics and all auxiliary passes.
Pin identical pretrained weight file SHA/revision and per-sample data/split/class-order manifest. Same timm ID or YAML alone is insufficient.
Resolve original unlogged min_lr, worker/pin/persistent policy, method defaults and RNG/environment versions; match them in new runs.
Use same experiment budget, class stream, evaluation metric and original nonseed hyperparameters; no per-seed best selection.
If identity cannot be recovered, run seeds 0/1/2 in one new frozen campaign. A numerically close seed0 check is useful diagnostics, not proof of historical source identity.
new_campaign_preflight: Freeze complete Flatness_CV dependency closure, not only learner files; include evaluation packages imported by trainer.
Keep historical documented schedules (including SD Aircraft .02 and Het5 30/40) to preserve requested table scope; protocol harmonization is a separate explicitly labeled comparison.
Pin data root+all train/test sample manifest+label/class order+task widths, all 5 Het5 components, transforms, pretrained safetensors SHA and timm revision.

Make all currently unlogged consumed defaults explicit or record resolved runtime values; train_num_workers=8, min_lr=0.1*lr, method defaults. Loader pin/persistent must be frozen in source or verified actual kwargs; arbitrary YAML keys may not be consumed.
Reserve unique run prefix/output root per seed; never write old outputs; prevent concurrent shared-checkpoint paths.
Run CPU import/config/data checks first, then gated smoke when training is authorized; verify task widths/model/rank/finite train metrics and CNN metric extraction.
Run new seed0 diagnostics for all20 groups before seed1/2; differences are investigated without tuning to match old test scores.
All successful selected seeds must be aggregated as mean and sample SD (ddof=1) from per-run FAA/AAA_stage. No substituting within-task/epoch dispersion or best seed.

timing.interpretation: Sum of observed single-run wall intervals only; not forecast, not measured GPU-hours. Parallel makespan requires contemporary smoke timings and resource availability.
